title: Marc Savard Comedy Hypnosis in Las Vegas
blurb: Experience the outrageous fun of Marc Savard Comedy Hypnosis in Las Vegas, a 75-minute, laugh-out-loud hypnotic show where volunteers become the stars of the stage. Watch as Marc Savard creates wild, unscripted chaos with hilarious dance battles, quirky personalities, and mind-bending moments you have to see to believe. With over 15 years headlining on the Las Vegas Strip, this high-energy comedy hypnosis show is a must-see live entertainment experience that keeps audiences coming back night after night.
